description: This file contains unit tests for the TextHelperService class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests string manipulation methods such as length calculation, containment, start, and end checks, including multi-byte string handling.

classes.name: TextHelperServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the TextHelperService class, verifying string manipulation functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the TextHelperService instance before each test.

methods.name: testStrLength
methods.description: Tests the string length calculation method with various strings, including multi-byte characters.

methods.name: testStrContains
methods.description: Verifies the substring containment method with different substrings, including empty and multi-byte characters.

methods.name: testStrStartsWith
methods.description: Checks whether strings start with specified substrings, including empty and multi-byte substrings.

methods.name: testStrEndsWith
methods.description: Checks whether strings end with specified substrings, including empty and multi-byte substrings.
